name: video-understanding
description: Progressive-disclosure video, image, and audio understanding router with a strict Native-First Gate. Uses built-in read_file (.1fps frame-held companions, <100 MB clips, local image crops) at $0 API spend first, escalating to the Gemini Interactions API only for >100 MB master videos, server-side frame-span slicing, opt-in agentic timeline navigation, 0..1000 2D box/polygon segmentation grounding, agentic code-execution zoom, and visual speaker transcription.
